jobs.description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.

Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Please review the job details below.

Vantor is seeking a Solution Engineer working within our product development team for the Raptor family of products (Guide, Sync, and Ace).  Raptor is a vision-based software suite designed to enable Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to navigate and operate in GPS-denied or contested environments. Based in Herndon, VA, this role is focused on advancing Raptor product software by providing direct development contributions as well as working with external customers and Vantor Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineering teams to characterize product performance in the field and capture requirements for product improvements.

The ideal candidate is a mission-oriented software engineer who thrives in fast-paced, customer-facing environments; is energized in the face of problems; and likes to push code. This role is defined as a “solution” engineer because it requires creative thinking, convincing communications, a problem-solving mindset, and a commitment to teamwork. To be successful in this role, a person must think at a systems level, have familiarity with embedded edge platforms, and have experience with sensor data flows, navigation solutions, and mission-critical applications.

As a Solution Engineer, you will participate in systems-level technical and engineering engagements with UAV OEMs, defense integrators, and mission focused customers. Your focus during these sessions will be on evaluating customer adoption of our products and converting customer experiences into tangible technical requirements. On occasion, you may be asked to help customers evaluate, integrate, and deploy our products, system components and early-stage solutions, into a variety of edge compute systems that process positioning and navigation signals. This position is ideal for a technically strong, hands-on engineer who can bridge the gap between software algorithms, OEM systems and field testing, and who thrives in dynamic, cross-functional environments.

The 3D Engineering team at Vantor is a dynamic, results-oriented engineering product development team consisting of subject matter experts (SMEs), software engineers, systems engineers, and solution architects.  This Solution Engineer will be a member of this team helping our customers bring our solutions to life in their systems, accelerating customer adoption, and driving real-world impact.  Our business is fueled by delivering tangible value to our customers, and we need new team members partner who want to drive making that happen.

Responsibilities: A day in the life/What the position will be doing:

Interface with existing Vantor Raptor customers worldwide to coordinate on integration of Raptor software into their systems architecture. Provide advice and guidance based on rigorous product knowledge and institutional experience base from past integrations.
Travel to customer sites to deliver technical product expertise.
Characterize product software performance of customer implementations and derive/capture technical requirements for feature improvements or additions.
Assist customers with field integration testing, including configuration of Jetson and raspberry Pi series companion computers, autopilot stacks (PX4, ArduPilot) and analysis of telemetry, imagery, and positioning data.
Assist in generating engineering technical designs involving the use of satellite imagery and full motion video to accomplish UAS visual positioning, odometry, and navigation.
Develop, document and convey technical and system requirements to product engineering team.
Work within product engineering team development process to make code contributions.
Communicate and collaborate across product, engineering, and GTM/sales teams to define and validate interfaces and data flows between Raptor products and OEM systems.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline (e.g., Aerospace, Computer Science, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Math) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience supporting ISR, UAS, aerospace, or defense system integrations
Strong programming skills in C, C++, Python, shell scripting
Experience with cross-compilation and toolchains
Good understanding of embedded systems, SoCs, and SBCs
Hands-on experience with low-level Linux (troubleshooting, configuration, e.g., kernel device drivers, library dependencies)
Experience in system design across hardware and software
Knowledge of networking and communication protocols (e.g., serial, TCP/IP, Wi-Fi)
Experience in customer-facing roles, support, and solution design
Strong communication skills and sound judgment in customer communication

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Vision, Software Engineering or a related technical field
Video formats and streaming protocols (e.g., MPEG-TS, MP4, RTSP)
Experience with multimedia frameworks (e.g., FFmpeg, GStreamer)
Experience with GIS systems, use cases, and software tools
Image processing and computer vision
Practical exposure to cameras and optics (e.g., lens models, calibration, distortion)
Understanding of aerial navigation (e.g., filtering, control theory, 3D spatial math)
Experience with UAS/UAV hardware and software (e.g., electromechanics, PX4, ArduPilot)
Experience with embedded Linux / edge compute platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm-based SoCs, Raspberry Pi)
Strategic and business-aware mindset
Structured and pedagogical mindset

Oracle is a global technology leader renowned for its innovative solutions in cloud computing, database management, and enterprise software. With a commitment to transforming businesses through cutting-edge technology, Oracle serves a diverse range of industries including finance, healthcare, government, and retail. The company emphasizes fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment that encourages continuous learning, collaboration, and growth. Oracle's dedication to excellence and customer satisfaction has established it as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to leverage technology for competitive advantage.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Data Analyst to join Oracle Health's Government Services team. In this pivotal role, you will analyze, prepare, and process complex data sets to generate actionable insights for both internal stakeholders and external clients. Your expertise will support statistical modeling, exploratory data analysis, and reporting functions that drive strategic decision-making and operational improvements. This position offers an opportunity to work on mission-critical projects within a collaborative environment, utilizing advanced analytical tools and methodologies to solve complex data challenges.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in data analytics, statistical analysis, data mining, predictive modeling, data management, and visualization is required. Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders, and communicate insights effectively is essential. Candidates must hold the appropriate government security clearance and be U.S. citizens due to client requirements. Preferred qualifications include at least 3 years of consulting experience, proficiency with analytical tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Oracle Analytics, and extensive experience with SQL.

Responsibilities

Analyze and interpret complex data sets from multiple sources to support exploratory and predefined analyses.
Audit data for completeness, validity, and overall data health, ensuring accuracy and reliability for analytical purposes.
Transform complex data into formats suitable for specific team functions, reporting, or visualization needs.
Conduct basic statistical testing and exploratory data analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and insights.
Create and maintain data visualizations that adhere to design and presentation standards to effectively communicate findings.
Collaborate with internal and external clients to identify key performance indicators and assess data availability.
Consult on Oracle Health reporting capabilities and provide end-user support for report access and execution.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within data workflows.
Maintain compliance with security policies and safeguard sensitive data assets.
Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management, including travel up to 25% as needed.

Benefits

Oracle offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of its employees. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, with access to expert medical opinions.
